headline: Vibra Energia Reports Q3 Net Profit of R$ 2.4 Billion
summary: Vibra Energia posted a third-quarter net profit of R$ 2.4 billion, with adjusted EBITDA reaching R$ 4.3 billion, more than double the performance recorded in the same period of 2025.
why: Vibra Energia is a major Brazilian fuel distribution company, formerly known as BR Distribuidora, which was privatized by Petrobras.

impacts.name: Vibra Energia
impacts.why: Strong earnings performance typically supports share price valuation.
